facts.author: Nik Koios
facts.headline: What's a Good Health Factor in DeFi? Managing Risk
facts.summary: In DeFi lending, the health factor is the number that decides whether your collateralized position is safe or about to be liquidated. This covers how it works on Aave versus Morpho, what counts as a safe buffer, and why a single tidy metric can hide the messy assumptions that fail in a crash.
